label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_02
text: Good evening, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_03
text: We are very grateful for all you did to help clear\nup that horrible confusion over dear Ogerpon.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_04
text: I never dreamt that the “Loyal Three” were in the\nwrong—and that poor Ogerpon was the victim![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_05
text: Why, we would have gone on passing down the\nwrong story without a second thought![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_06
text: All that being said![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_07
text: While I do fully understand that the Loyal Three\nwere villains...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_08
text:
You’ve seen the state of Loyalty Plaza, yes?\c
The statues are ruined—shattered to pieces when
those three were resurrected!\c
Doesn’t it pain your heart to see it so?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_09
text: And only too right! I knew a student of a fine\nacademy like yours must appreciate the\r\nsignificance of such a site![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_10
text:
Oh? You DID see what that place looked like
before the monument was destroyed, didn’t you?\c
I’m sure you mourn for the loss of such a site,
even if your words tell another story.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_11
text:
Yes, the actual “Loyal Three” were in the wrong.
But the monument brought so many touri—\c
I mean, it brought so much comfort and hope to
the people of our village for generations.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_12
text:
Which is why...\c
I have begun a fundraiser to restore that beloved
site to its former state—and I am calling it the
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]“We Love Loyalty Plaza” drive[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_13
text: We are looking for donations of 10,000, with\nthe ultimate goal of gathering 1,000,000![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_14
text: Be that as it may, I couldn’t possibly take that\nkind of money from a student such as yourself...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_15
text: But perhaps you could subtly nudge your parents\nor teachers to contribute to our cause![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_16
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]We’ve collected a total of [VAR 0x0206(0001,002C)] so far for\nthe\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]“We Love Loyalty Plaza” drive[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_select_01
text: I’ll give [VAR 0xBD03(0000)]10,000

label: s1_sub_015_select_03
text: Maybe next time

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_17
text: You’d be so kind as to give 10,000 to our\nfundraiser?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_18
text: Goodness me! You really wish to give us an\nentire 100,000 at once?![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_19
text: We’ll reach that 1,000,000 in due time—\nyou’ll see! And I’ll be here until we do![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_20
text: It seems you don’t have enough money to make\nthat sort of donation...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_21
text: Well, I accept your kind support with gratitude!\nAnd here—a little something for you in return.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_22
text: Our goal is to raise a total of 1,000,000, and\nwe’ve raised [VAR 0x0206(0001,002C)] so far![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_23
text: With that donation— O-oh my...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_38
text: We’ve reached our goal of 1,000,000![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_24
text: Now we can at last restore Loyalty Plaza to the\nway it was![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_25
text: Let me call our contractor at once...\n*beep* *boop* *beep* *beep*[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_26
text: Hello? Yes, yes, it’s me again. We were able to\nraise the funds for the project!\c\nWe’d love to see work get started at once![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_27
text: They say they’re already done! Why don’t we\nhead over to see the fruits of your labor?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_28
text: Ohhh... Would you just look—![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_29
text: Thanks to our “We Love Loyalty Plaza” drive,\nthe old monument has been reborn![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_30
text: Goodness, did they ever do a fine job! It’s hard\nto believe it’s not the exact same monument![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_worker_01
text: We even re-created the scratches and blemishes\nit had before!

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_31
text: Hahaha! Now THAT is true craftsmanship and\ndedication for you![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_32
text:
This is just what the village needed!\c
Yes, just what we needed...to draw in more
tourists who’ll want to take photos here!\c
We’ll be topping the tourism charts in no time![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_37
text: Hurray! Hurray! Come on, all together now![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_system_02
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Hurray! emote [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from the\ncaretaker!

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_33
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I also have a special gift for you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
for
being
our
number
one
supporter.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_system_01
text: You obtained the[VAR 0xFF00(0008)] Festival Jinbei (Flashy)[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_34
text: We had a bit left over from the fundraiser, so\nI went ahead and glammed that up for you.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_35
text: Wear it out and about to advertise the wonders\nof Kitakami to all your friends in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_36
text: Hmm... Perhaps my next goal should be to open\nup a stylish café at Loyalty Plaza...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
